notes: M7 part d: the 32 ForMathlib files merged from main (#21, #24) map to themselves; all import only Mathlib or other ForMathlib files and use the project-wide flat `namespace NLAlib` (no NLAlib-specific definitions or objects).
Nested ForMathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Triangular.lean is kept as is (nested paths under a ForMathlib area are allowed); it concerns Mathlib's `Matrix` and `IsLowerTriangular`, not NLAlib's matrices.

Schur family (SchurTriangularization, OrderedSchur, SimultaneousTriangularization, OrderedSimultaneousSchur, PencilTriangularization, TriangularBasis, Orthonormal*, InvariantCompression) is stated for abstract inner-product spaces / LinearMaps and stays in ForMathlib/Analysis; CommonEigenvector, OrderedCommonEigenvector, PencilLine stay in ForMathlib/LinearAlgebra.
flags: NLAlib/ForMathlib/Algebra/InterlacingWeights.lean and NLAlib/ForMathlib/Order/InterlacingDeletion.lean: scalar real-list/real-polynomial facts named after eigenvalue interlacing (bordered / rank-one interlacing hypotheses stated on Fin n → ℝ); genuinely Mathlib-level but specialised to ℝ and to the interlacing-converse proof; kept in ForMathlib, upstream would likely want generalisation to an ordered field.
NLAlib/ForMathlib/Algebra/InterlacingInterpolation.lean: Lagrange-interpolation identity for ℝ[X]; fits Mathlib's Polynomial/Lagrange area better than Algebra/ (no move proposed).

Area placement (not ownership) quibbles, no move proposed: OrthonormalEigenline.lean and IsolatedCharpoly.lean are charpoly facts arguably LinearAlgebra rather than Analysis; SeparatingRows.lean is about Matrix.mulVec over ℝ (LinearAlgebra/Matrix would match the nested Triangular.lean).
